name: Della Keys
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: Della is very good at raising money for things a committee can own. Paying for a journey whose only result is seeing a sister again feels uncomfortably difficult to photograph for the annual report. On Friday, near Lighthouse Cove, Della takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: We offered to buy the lamp as a landmark. He reminded me his wife's sister is still alive. I changed the vote to a travel allowance so he can deliver it himself.
appearance: Della has a blunt cut just below the ears, a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, and a favorite piece of clothing, a faded indigo overshirt. It usually goes with a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. When somebody else has the floor, Della rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Della is firm about boundaries and unusually forgiving of somebody who admits to crossing one. Demands to act grateful for unwanted help can end a friendship.
agenda: To pay for the owner's visit to his wife's sister.
family: Ariel Pinto is Della’s half-sibling. Della leaves the first voice message. Ariel calls back when there is finally a little privacy. In their family a missed ring can mean a bus, a customer, a sleeping child or a bad hour. Neither treats it as an answer in itself. Asked about *The new language at dinner*, Ariel says, “I translated our first visit and cried in the lift because he sounded exactly like my late father.”
connections: Gus Lark. The hardware ledger gives the committee a less costly way to commemorate the lamp than buying it.

reactions.situation: A shift worker turns up after the porch goes dark
reactions.response: Della keeps the worker company at the gate and lets the homeowner explain the dark.
